The course is fairly easy. It mostly consists of memorising business concepts, with just the last few chapters dedicated to financial accounting so it is definitely not a math-heavy course. The fact that we are allowed to have cheat-sheets in exams are very helpful and motivating. It not only forces us to study but also tells us that it’s important to learn the topics and not memorize them. There are not many homework or quizzes, and as long as you attend the lectures and take notes it is easy to learn. The course covers the main functions of a business so if you are not yet sure on which you want to focus on in the future, it is a great place to decide on what excites you most. 

Although one negative thing is that if people are present in the simulation classes, even if they do not have any input to the reflection papers, they still get the same grade as the other members who do the work. This is unfair in my opinion and should be handled differently. For instance, those who work on the reflections could write their names on the document and all of those names could receive the same grade. If one has no impact, their name would not be there, and as a result they would get a zero. Just sitting there during simulations and not contributing to reflections should not be rewarded.
